what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: In person at Town Hall; also Zoom (https://us02web.zoom.us/j/9091740347?omn=86083579375, Meeting ID 909 174 0347, phone (888) 475-4499) and broadcast on Lunenburg Public Access, Facebook Live and YouTube. Remote access is a courtesy and the meeting continues if it fails.

items.agenda_line: Motion to Enter into Executive Session and not to re-enter Open Session after exiting Executive Session
items.why_it_matters: The board may close the session to consider the purchase, exchange, lease or value of real property, naming the Lunenburg Food Pantry License Agreement, and the public cannot attend that part or return to open session afterward.

items.agenda_line: Public Hearing for Tax Classification Hearing: To determine the percentage of the local tax levy to be borne by each class of real property. The hearing will include a presentation by Brian Fernandes, Principal Assessor and
items.why_it_matters: This hearing, with a presentation by the Principal Assessor and Board of Assessors on options under Chapter 40, Section 56, concerns how the local tax levy is shared among classes of real property, which affects tax bills.

items.agenda_line: Direct Local Technical Assistance (DLTA) Funding Request to the Montachusett Regional Planning
items.why_it_matters: The Director of Planning and Economic Development presents a funding request to the regional planning commission to update the town's Housing Production Plan.

items.agenda_line: Public Hearing Petition for Conduit Location by Verizon on Williams Drive to place one two-inch underground
items.why_it_matters: Hearing on Verizon's petition to place about 600 feet of underground telecommunications conduit along Williams Drive from the corner of Island Road, work in a public way.

items.agenda_line: Public Hearing Petition for Conduit Location by Verizon on Country Road to place one two-inch underground
items.why_it_matters: Hearing on Verizon's petition to place about 368 feet of underground telecommunications conduit along Country Road from the corner of Chase Road.

items.agenda_line: Public Hearing Petition for Conduit Location by Verizon on Chase Road to place one two-inch underground
items.why_it_matters: Hearing on Verizon's petition for underground telecommunications conduit along and across Chase Road, ending at Pole T. 51.
The board is to discuss follow-up after the Special Town Meeting; the agenda gives no further detail.
The board is to review the goals set for the Town Manager for fiscal year 2027, which guide town management priorities.
Old business on the town's municipal buildings; the agenda lists no specifics.
